claim_text: Pilots should comply with ATC instructions as soon as they are issued, unless the instruction includes 'When Ready', in which case compliance is left to pilot discretion.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The order of items in a position report is: Callsign, Position, Time at position, Level or altitude, Next position, ETA at next position.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Control is based on known traffic only, so pilots are still responsible for safe procedures and good judgment.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Specific vectors may be given for lateral separation purposes, after which the pilot may resume own navigation.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Advisory avoiding action provided during a Radar Advisory Service should not be ignored; if ignored, the pilot must advise ATC.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Area controllers control aircraft passing through airspace without landing, and are not necessarily based at an airport.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Under RADAR Control' indicates that a radar control service is being provided, meaning the pilot must comply with instructions unless avoiding immediate danger, and ATC assumes responsibility for separation and terrain avoidance.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When receiving a Radar Advisory Service, the pilot will be given the bearing, distance, and height of known conflicting traffic, plus advisory avoiding action.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When receiving a Radar Information Service, the pilot remains responsible for separation from other aircraft and terrain avoidance.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A Radar Information Service (RIS) is available under both IFR and VFR.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Orbits (complete turns) may be used for delaying purposes or for increasing separation.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Under IFR in controlled airspace, the pilot will be given a descent clearance to the limit used by ACC before handover to Approach.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Squawking ident is the only form of radar identification that does not require a backup method such as a turn.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The pilot should be advised if radar identification is lost or about to be lost, and appropriate instructions should be given.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Radar identification can be established by position reporting, relation to a prominent object, making turns visible on radar, or identing with SSR.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Heading information and instructions are provided in degrees magnetic.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When receiving a Radar Advisory Service, the pilot remains responsible for terrain avoidance.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A Flight Information Service is not a radar service.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The use of the calling aeronautical station’s callsign followed by the answering aeronautical station’s callsign shall be considered the invitation to proceed with transmission by the station calling.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase Pass Your Message may be used when considered to be appropriate.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The abbreviation of callsign XY-ABC to Y-BC is not an ICAO Standard.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Clearances are valid only in controlled airspace and are identified by the presence of the word 'clear' in the text.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: If a pilot does not like a clearance or instruction, they should say so at the time.

notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: Instructions are identifiable, though the word 'instruct' may not be included.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Heading, speed and level instructions, including Transition Levels, must be read back.
test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: Clearances should be read back in full, in the order given.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A transmission should be started with the callsign of the service provider followed by the aircraft callsign.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Request joining instructions, stating the ATIS version you have.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Air Traffic Control Service (ATC) can only be provided by licensed Air Traffic Control Officers (ATCOs) who are closely regulated by the Authority.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Obtain the ATIS or current weather.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: If ATC require you to Go Around, they will say so, at which point you climb away and start the circuit again. You can initiate a Go Around at any time by saying Going Around.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Request startup clearance, stating the ATIS version you have.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Change to Tower for takeoff clearance.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Report position in the circuit, such as downwind, finals, etc.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Repeat testing shall be the minimum necessary.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Conditional clearances must be given in the specific order: aircraft identification, the condition (specify), and the subject of the condition.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: An example of a conditional clearance readback is 'Behind the A 340, Line Up, G-PACO' for the clearance 'G-PACO - Behind the A 340, Line up'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format may include other information such as endurance remaining, number of people on board, aircraft colour/markings, or survival aids.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The distress call may be transmitted using the letters SOS in Morse Code.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The distress call may be transmitted using the spoken words MAYDAY, repeated 3 times.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Control of distress traffic is the responsibility of the aircraft in distress.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format includes the position.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The Distress call (MAYDAY) is used when threatened by grave and imminent danger and in most urgent need of immediate assistance.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format includes the name of the station addressed.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format includes the aircraft callsign.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format includes the intentions of the PIC.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The STUDENT prefix shall also be used in other circumstances where a licence holder is returning to flying practice after a significant absence and undergoing renewal training involving solo flight under supervision.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Pilot qualifications should be included in a distress message whenever possible in UK emergency contexts, though there is no ICAO requirement.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format includes the aircraft type.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Solo student pilots shall prefix the aircraft callsign with STUDENT to indicate their lack of experience.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A distress message format includes the nature of the emergency.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A blue and white chequered flag means Much Regret, Unable (i.e. NO).
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A series of Ns in Morse Code means Much Regret, Unable (i.e. NO).
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: To cancel a MAYDAY, the pilot shall state MAYDAY once, say ALL STATIONS three times, provide Aircraft ID, Station called, Time, Name of station in distress, DISTRESS TRAFFIC ENDED, Station called, and OUT.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: If compelled to land but not needing immediate help, the pilot should switch landing lights and/or navigation lights on and off in an irregular pattern.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: An Urgency call (PAN) indicates a very urgent message concerning safety where immediate assistance is not required, and has priority over all messages except Distress.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase CANCEL DISTRESS may be used as an alternative to the standard MAYDAY cancellation sequence.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The format for an Urgency message includes: Callsign, Type, Nature of emergency, Intentions of PIC, Position, Pilot qualifications, and Any other information.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: If unable to change the squawk code during an emergency, the pilot should keep pressing the Ident button.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The squawk code for an emergency is 7700.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Distress/Urgency messages must include the nature of the emergency, fuel endurance and persons on board.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Imposing radio silence is done by saying 'Stop Transmitting - MAYDAY', after which everyone should keep quiet.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Take a bearing on the transmission.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: At your discretion, whilst awaiting further instructions, proceed to the position given. Once there, if a rescue is in progress, do not interfere without checking with whoever is in charge.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase No Delay Expected means holding will be less than 20 minutes before starting an approach.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: In UK, flight crews of aircraft short on fuel must declare a PAN or MAYDAY to ensure being given the appropriate priority.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Inform the appropriate ATS unit or RCC.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: If you need to direct another craft to the scene, circle it at least once, fly low just in front and rock the fuselage, then fly off in the direction you want them to go.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: If and when the threat is over, the Distress call must be cancelled by notification on ALL frequencies on which the original message was sent.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: An emergency exists the moment you become doubtful about position, fuel, weather, or anything else that could affect the safety of your flight.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Record the position of the craft in distress, if given.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Distress transmissions are normally given out on the frequency in use at the time.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: ELTs operate on 121.5 MHz and 406 MHz.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When over the high seas, you will typically be guarding one of the distress frequencies, either 121.5 MHz, 243 MHz or 2182 KHz for merchant shipping.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The word 'Cleared' is only used in connection with a clearance to takeoff and land; otherwise 'cross' and 'approved' are used.
test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: Until cleared for takeoff or cancellation, the word 'Departure' is used.
test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: Radio transmissions for test purposes should be as short as possible and not more than 10 seconds.
test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: Readback must be in full and in the same sequence as given, with the condition first.
test_or_evidence_target: FN33 ICAO 9432 readback slice / future direct source evidence
notes: Overlaps ICAO 9432 readback requirements; useful supporting/training evidence, but should not duplicate primary-source tests.

claim_text: Conditional clearances need only contain key elements and sufficient detail to clearly indicate compliance.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Break' indicates separation between parts of a message.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Cancel' means to annul a previously transmitted message.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Check' means to examine a system.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Confirm' asks 'Did I get that right?'
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When the last two figures of a frequency are zero, use four figures for transmission and readback.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: In airspace with 25 KHz channel separation and no operational requirement for six figures, use the first five figures.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: The phrase 'Changing to' indicates going to another frequency.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Cleared' means to proceed under the conditions specified.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The word 'Over' may be omitted if the reply is obvious and there will be no misunderstanding.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: In the UK, the word 'To' is not used with flight levels (e.g., 'Climb Flight Level 100') to prevent confusion with the number two, whereas 'To' is used with climb and descent instructions relating to heights or altitudes.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Use the words 'This Is' followed by your identifier; use the full callsign on initial contact, but may subsequently use abbreviations made by ATC.
notes: Fallback EPPLS classification: review before executable treatment.

claim_text: Normally, the pilot's callsign is the same as the aircraft's markings, unless permission has been applied for and granted to use a company name or flight number.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When transmitting messages containing aircraft callsigns, altimeter settings, flight levels (with the exception of FL100, 200, 300 etc. which are expressed as Flight Level (number) HUNDRED), headings, wind speeds/directions, pressure settings, airspeed, transponder codes and frequencies, each digit shall be transmitted separately.
notes: Fallback EPPLS classification: review before executable treatment.

claim_text: Numbers should be spoken individually using the phonetic speech equivalents: 0-ZERO, 1-WUN, 2-TOO, 3-TREE, 4-FOWER, 5-FIFE, 6-SICKS, 7-SEVEN, 8-AIT, 9-NINER.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: QNH 1000 is expressed as one zero zero zero.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A message consists of four parts: The Callup, The Reply, The Message and The Acknowledgment.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The word decimal (daysimal) shall be used for a decimal point; for example, one one six decimal two means 116.2.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: In the UK, Flight Levels are expressed in hundreds (e.g., one hundred, two hundred) rather than the ICAO standard, and flight levels below FL 100 use two-digit numbers.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Altitude above sea level is expressed in thousands of feet plus hundreds (e.g., 2500 is two thousand five hundred).
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Combinations of thousands and whole hundreds must be transmitted by pronouncing each digit in the number of thousands, followed by the word Thousand, followed by the number of hundreds, followed by the word Hundred.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A readability grade of 4 indicates 'readable'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: An aeronautical station operator may reply with 'STATION CALLING (frequency or 8.33 channel) UNREADABLE' when the transmission is unreadable.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A readability grade of 3 indicates 'readable with difficulty'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A readability grade of 5 indicates 'perfectly readable'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A readability grade of 1 indicates 'unreadable'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A readability grade of 2 indicates 'readable now and then'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: An example of a readability reply is 'Reading you Strength Three'.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Pilots must report their position and height on entering and just before leaving an ATZ.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: A continuous listening watch should be maintained at all times, especially when transiting controlled airspace during notified hours of watch.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Pilots should wait a split second to speak after pressing the transmit button to allow system relays to switch over.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: Decimal is used when reading back a frequency, whereas point is used when describing a frequency spacing such as eight point three three.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: It is an offence to use a callsign for a purpose other than that for which it is notified.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: To indicate 8.33 kHz capability, the phrase 'AFFIRM EIGHT POINT THREE THREE' shall be used.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: Communications should be restricted to what is required for the task in hand, using concise and unambiguous phraseology to avoid RTF congestion.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Pilots should use standard phraseology, maintain radio discipline with unambiguous language, monitor frequencies, pass relevant phase-of-flight information, wait and listen before transmitting on new frequencies, check frequency if quiet, set the clearance given not expected, note down clearances, and check if unsure.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The correct procedure for setting the Squelch is to rotate the knob until the hiss just stops and leave it there.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: To indicate lack of 8.33 kHz capability, the phrase 'NEGATIVE EIGHT POINT THREE THREE' shall be used.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: English must be used for air–ground communications unless an alternative has been arranged with ATC.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: Pilots are bound to preserve the secrecy of communications and may not disclose the existence or content of transmissions except to authorized recipients, with exceptions for distress, safety, or All Stations messages.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: In the open FIR, with unlimited visibility and no cloud, land at the nearest suitable aerodrome and inform ATC.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: If able, squawk Mode C to provide a height readout.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: If you don't need to enter controlled airspace, carry on, maintaining VFR as necessary; don't enter it even if you've been previously cleared.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: Transmit messages twice, preceded by the words 'Transmitting Blind', if the set is transmitting.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: If only receiving, fly in a right-handed pattern for a minute (two minutes if over 300 knots) at best endurance speed with tight 120-degree turns.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: ATC may send a shepherd aircraft to formate on you and bring you down if they recognize the problem.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: If in doubt, clear the zone the most direct way as quickly as possible, avoiding airfields, and making blind transmissions.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: If unable to transmit or receive, go to the left.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: Squawk 7600 for communications failure.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: If in a circuit and radio fails, repeatedly switch the landing lights on and off.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: If you must enter controlled airspace, divert and telephone for permission first.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: Make reports at scheduled times or positions, preceded by the phrase 'Transmitting Blind due to receiver failure'.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: Comply with the last clearance, which hopefully included permission to land, or clear the area.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: Try another frequency or talk to other aircraft to verify radio status; ensure facility is open, in range, correct frequency selected, and volume set.
notes: Relevant future abnormal/emergency communications material, but requires emergency/lost-comms scenario modeling.

claim_text: Taxi instructions contain a clearance limit, which is a point beyond which the aircraft must not go without further permission; this is normally the holding point of the runway in use.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Departure clearances given by Ground are not clearances to takeoff.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Traffic close to the aerodrome, including the circuit, typically remains with Tower until clear of the area, rather than changing to Approach immediately after takeoff.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Being told to 'continue' due to traffic on the runway is not a clearance to land; permission to land is still required.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: When requesting start, it often helps to state the current location and include the current ATIS code.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: A normal final approach is within 4 nm of the runway, while long finals is between 4 and 8 nm.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The words 'go around' mean initiate a missed approach.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The Ground Controller handles all movements on the manoeuvring area, including aircraft and vehicles, and possibly start clearances.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: In a standard overhead join at 2000 feet, the pilot should call 'Deadside Descending' on the dead side.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Clearances will contain the aircraft identification.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: Clearances are supposed to be passed slowly and clearly, preferably before startup.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: The phrase 'Approved' means 'Permission granted for proposed action'.

claim_text: The phrase 'Affirm' means 'Agreement'.

claim_text: The phrase 'Recleared' means 'Ignore your last clearance, receive a new one'.

claim_text: Correction means Oops - made a mistake

claim_text: Disregard means Ignore my last
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.

claim_text: To get something repeated, use the words say again.
test_or_evidence_target: future phraseology rendering/linting layer
notes: Phraseology/RT rendering material; current simulator models typed messages more than rendered words.

claim_text: Confirm Squawk means “What code is set on your transponder?”

claim_text: I say again means I repeat

claim_text: In the UK, the term 'Pass Your Message' is used instead of 'Request'.

claim_text: You can Request a Time Check from ATC at any time.
notes: Registry marked review_only; EPPLS is training/textbook support and needs domain review before simulator treatment.
